text: Finished high school studies, aged under 30 and healthy. If failed in HSK, students can attend Chinese language classes after enrollment, and begin medical studies after passing the examination. Materials Needed: 1. A photocopy of the applicant's passport; 2. Passport-size photo; 3. An official certificate of high school graduation certificate; 4. A photocopy of the transcript; 5. A photocopy of HSK certificate; 6. A photocopy of Physical Examination Form for Foreigners
